mapper.insert: SELECT group_seq.NEXTVAL FROM dual INSERT INTO studygroup ( group_num, group_title, group_desc, group_isPrivate, group_maxMembers, group_thumbnail, group_invitecode, created_at ) VALUES ( #{group_num}, #{group_title}, #{group_desc}, #{group_isPrivate}, #{group_maxMembers}, #{group_thumbnail, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{group_invitecode, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, SYSDATE )
mapper.select: SELECT tag_num, tag_name, tag_color FROM studytag WHERE LOWER(tag_name) LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{keyword}) || '%' ORDER BY tag_name FETCH FIRST 10 ROWS ONLY
SELECT tag_num, tag_name, tag_color FROM studytag WHERE LOWER(tag_name) = LOWER(#{tag_name})
mapper.insert: SELECT studytag_seq.NEXTVAL FROM dual INSERT INTO studytag ( tag_num, tag_name, tag_color ) VALUES (#{tag_num}, #{tag_name}, #{tag_color} )
INSERT INTO group_member ( group_num, member_num, is_leader) VALUES (#{group_num}, #{member_num}, #{is_leader})
mapper.select: SELECT g.group_num, g.group_title, g.group_desc, g.group_isPrivate, g.group_maxMembers, g.group_thumbnail, g.group_invitecode, g.created_at, gm.is_leader, (SELECT count(*) FROM group_member gm2 WHERE gm2.group_num = g.group_num) AS current_members FROM studygroup g JOIN group_member gm ON g.group_num = gm.group_num where gm.member_num = #{member_num} ORDER BY created_at desc
